entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ASP0027 should not trigger when there are attributes attached to the partial class declaration #64428
  • ASP0027 points to non-existing webpage #64427
  • OpenApiXmlCommentSupport borked when used with document transformers when using Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi 10.0.0 #64425
  • _MvcCopyDependencyFiles Target is showing up on incremental build hot paths #64423
  • Blazor SessionData #64422
    Backlog
  • Visual Studio insiders 2026 blazor server side for .net 8 format does not work #64421
  • Missing GrpcXmlCommentsDocumentFilter, GrpcXmlCommentsOperationFilter in Microsoft.AspNetCore.Grpc.Swagger v0.10.0 #64424
  • QueryStringRequestCultureProvider does not work with @rendermode InteractiveServer #64420
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #64415
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #64414
  • Add `RoutePattern` property to `ApiDescription` #64412
  • Hot reload: gray overlay shown with no error messages #64411
    Backlog

Closed

  • Lack of SignalR typescript client release notes #50772
    Post-10-GA
  • Perf improvement: updates #64402
  • Perf regression: antiforgery-noop #64417
  • .NET 10: Component parameter two-way binding breaks when set directly in tests #64419
